snippet.title: Age of Wonders 4 | Expansion Pass 4 Reveal!
snippet.description:
Ride the storm toward uncharted seas, enchanted forests, and ancient forges with Age of Wonders 4: Expansion Pass 4, available now! Available for purchase today on PC, PlayStation®5, and Xbox Series X|S consoles.  

The pass brings together four content releases into a single bundle, starting with Singer of Storms Insta Unlock, available immediately. Set sail for The Silver Seas on November 3, 2026, then look forward to Court of the Archfey in Q1 2027 and Forge of the Firstborn in Q2 2027.

Learn more: https://pdxint.at/aow4-ep4
